notes: Main line: single-bead laser cladding of 420 MSS on 1018 steel -> zones BZ/DZ/IZ/HAZ -> PAG morphology gradient (solidification, G/R) -> full martensite (fast differential cooling) -> coarser martensite in DZ, more GOS strain in BZ/HAZ, IQ-inferred lattice-distortion gradients -> jointly the residual-stress profile (F11, reproduced from earlier XRD+simulation work) -> IQ tracks RS inversely (method claim) -> conclusion. Audits: GOS vs IQ disagree in HAZ (a1, L2); IQ-RS inversion mixes signed and magnitude RS (a2); scan IQ averages differ fourfold so only within-scan trends are comparable (a3, text-silent); delta-ferrite not separable from martensite (L1). Packet issues: F1 image (paper Fig. 1 schematic/photo) has no caption; F2 image is paper Fig. 3 PQ maps but carries a concatenated Fig. 1 + Fig. 3 caption, and F2a/F2b caption spans are garbled (F2a span says 'Schematic view of the laser cladding process'); F3 is paper Fig. 2. F10 colour-bar maxima (1308, 583) disagree with text ranges 142-485 and 145-450. PAG averages in text look small against visible F5 grains. F10e linked text contradicts itself on the DZ(C) trend.
